steps.operation: validate snapshot identity and authorized root boundary
validate pinned registry, declaration, profile and budget ceilings
collect directory entries without following symlinks; stop at hard/nested-repository boundaries
visit entries in normalized POSIX byte order; reject depth/file/candidate/byte budget exhaustion
read only bounded recognized markers; never evaluate imports, macros or scripts
parse and normalize owner, unit identity, language, capabilities and references
reject unknowns, malformed markers, invalid paths and conflicting owner identities
apply exclusions/includes, nearest ownership and same-owner deduplication
reject cross-owner overlap; retain missing project references and explicit coverage loss
sort all output; return canonical inventory separately from operational telemetry
return explicit complete/partial/ambiguous/unsupported/failed status; never serialize timestamps into inventory bytes

adapterSteps.operation: bind repository revision, unitKey, source/config digests and selected closed profile
verify producer/toolchain name, version and executable digest; negotiate only declared features
require an already provisioned trusted toolchain in offline credential-free isolation; never run repository scripts
reject unknown profile/capability or unavailable toolchain as unsupported, not empty success
validate every source span against frozen bytes; preserve source coordinate encoding and provenance
preserve resolved/static-target/candidate/unresolved state and evidence; never promote weaker resolution
compute file/fact coverage, omitted paths, diagnostics and complete/partial/failed status; keep telemetry separate
canonicalize ordered facts/evidence without operational timestamps; emit only the new draft envelope
translate only facts representable by the selected closed consumer profile; malformed or unknown old-consumer inputs fail closed
qualify against an independently authored gold inventory/link/span set; report measured precision, recall and false/missing links
compare producer evidence and recorded demand before a bounded, reversible pilot; otherwise stop without language selection

complexity.sorting: O((F + M + R) log(F + M + R))
